# Hypothesis: which comps have a full ring of 7 (on both sides) in output, and check their bbox margins
def full_ring(g,out,cn):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[]
    seen=set()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; cp=[]; seen.add((i,j))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==0 and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                r1,r2,c1,c2=min(a for a,b in cp),max(a for a,b in cp),min(b for a,b in cp),max(b for a,b in cp)
                # expanded bbox must be inside grid & perimeter all cn in out
                HR=max(r1-1,0); RR=min(r2+1,H-1); HC=max(c1-1,0); CC=min(c2+1,W-1)
                ok=(r1-1>=0 and r2+1<H and c1-1>=0 and c2+1<W
                    and all(out[r1-1][j]==cn for j in range(c1,c2+1))
                    and all(out[r2+1][j]==cn for j in range(c1,c2+1))
                    and all(out[i][c1-1]==cn for i in range(r1,r2+1))
                    and all(out[i][c2+1]==cn for i in range(r1,r2+1)))
                res.append(((r1,r2,c1,c2),len(cp),ok))
    return res

G=load()
def comps_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; cp=[]; seen.add((i,j))
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cp.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==0 and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                res.append(cp)
    return res
di=G['Demo pair 5 input']; do=G['Demo pair 5 output']
for cp in comps_of(di):
    rs=[a for a,b in cp]; cs=[b for a,b in cp]
    r1,r2,c1,c2=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    U=r1-1>=0 and all(di[r1-1][b]!=0 for b in range(c1,c2+1))
    D=r2+1<len(di) and all(di[r2+1][b]!=0 for b in range(c1,c2+1))
    L=c1-1>=0 and all(di[a][c1-1]!=0 for a in range(r1,r2+1))

    print(len(cp),(r1,r2,c1,c2),'U',U,'D',D,'L',L,'R',R,'OUT ring:',OU,D&OD and OL&OL and OR&OR,(OU,OD,OL,OR))
